scored.title: Agent-to-agent (A2A) endpoint
scored.kill: Do not build unless three paying accounts commit to a pilot.
scored.problem: Some enterprise customers build multi-agent systems and ask for A2A alongside MCP.
scored.hypothesis: An A2A endpoint over the same grounding service opens accounts that do not use MCP clients.

scored.title: Charts in AI answers
scored.kill: Do not build if a prototype with five customers does not change how often they come back.
scored.problem: Users copy numbers into slides; the research assistant cannot return a chart.
scored.hypothesis: Returning a chart specification with the citation increases repeat use.

scored.title: Cache statistics by version
scored.kill: Roll back on any stale answer traced to the cache.
scored.problem: Popular statistics are fetched from the warehouse thousands of times a week.
scored.hypothesis: A cache keyed by statistic and version (invalidated by the revision stream) cuts warehouse cost and latency with no staleness.

scored.title: Learn the words customers use
scored.kill: Stop if analysts reject more than half of the proposed synonyms, or verified answers do not rise in the canary.
scored.problem: People ask in their own words ("e-car registrations", "Deutschland"); the catalogue only knows the analysts' words, so the search misses or picks the wrong statistic.
scored.hypothesis: Synonyms mined from rephrased questions in the MCP session logs, reviewed by analysts, recover most of those misses.

scored.title: Understand where and when a question is about
scored.kill: Roll back if, after two weeks on 10% of accounts, wrong-number share has not fallen by a fifth or verified answers fell.
scored.problem: Searches ignore the geography and year in the question, so "EV sales in Germany 2023" can return France, and a place we do not cover gets a neighbour's number.
scored.hypothesis: Parsing geography and year as filters, and answering "not covered" for places outside the catalogue, cuts wrong numbers without losing right ones.

scored.title: Contract checks in producers' own CI
scored.kill: Stop if producer teams do not adopt it within a month (fewer than half of deliveries checked in CI).
scored.problem: A delivery that breaks its contract is refused at the door and waits days for a platform engineer's review; meanwhile customers get the old number.
scored.hypothesis: Running the same contract checks in the producers' pipelines catches most breaks before delivery and gets the fix live the same day.
